messages:
Noah Kim: quick design QA on the Roles summary panel — compact view option seems to save vertical space but i'm worried the legend becomes ambiguous. sharing screenshots.
Priya Desai: saw that. issue 1: the color chip for 'admin' doesn't meet 4.5:1 on the light background. can we pick a darker hue or add a pattern?
Evan Brooks: +1 on contrast. pattern might be noisy in a dense table. prefer darken the chip and keep text bold. also consider adding a subtle outline for the chip so it reads against both light/dark themes.
Noah Kim: agree on outline. microcopy question: current tooltip says 'Role: Admin' — feels redundant. suggestion: tooltip should be 'Admin — full access to org settings' (brief capability hint).
Ruth Gomez: a11y nit: tooltip needs role="tooltip" and an aria-describedby on the chip so screen readers announce the hint. also the tooltip should appear on focus, not just hover.
Priya Desai: keyboard: when tabbing through the roles matrix, focus order should be: row checkbox -> role name -> actions menu. right now actions menu steals focus after role name which is confusing.
Evan Brooks: yep, seen that. propose adding a focus ring that stays until action menu is explicitly opened. also don't auto-open menus on focus.
Noah Kim: copy tweak for SSO toggle in org settings: current label 'Require SSO for org' is fine but confirmation modal reads 'Enforce SSO'. mismatch. unify to 'Enforce SSO' everywhere. also add one-line help text: 'Enabling prevents password sign-in for members.'
Ruth Gomez: modal accessibility: when the SSO toggle triggers the modal, focus should move to the modal heading and trap focus. Screen reader should read the short rationale and the primary CTA.
Priya Desai: export/print: if someone prints the Roles matrix, the compact legend should expand for readability. print CSS should override chip colors and include text labels next to chips.
Evan Brooks: concerning dense rows: the hover affordance showing the last modified date hides the role description. can we move last-modified to a secondary column or a small icon that expands?
Noah Kim: small icon (+ tooltip) sounds good. less overlap. also we discussed a 'row summary' popover on hover for managers — contains member count, pending invites, linked snapshots. keep that optional behind a feature flag.
Ruth Gomez: on-screen contrast test: run with 3 simulated vision conditions (deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia) — capture screenshots and include pass/fail. I'll run them once colors are adjusted.
Priya Desai: design decision: compact vs comfy density toggle in top-right of matrix. default for new orgs is comfy, existing orgs keep compact. thoughts?
Evan Brooks: default comfy seems safer for accessibility. compact as opt-in saves us from complaints.
Noah Kim: ok default comfy. action items: Evan -> adjust chips and outline + update focus behavior; Ruth -> aria + SR test plan; Priya -> copy for SSO modal + density toggle language; Noah -> update figma with print rules and popover wire. target: mock ready by EOD Wed.
OncallBot: scheduled maintenance notice: Console will be upgraded Wednesday 23:00 UTC (no downtime expected).
Noah Kim: noted, will try to have mocks before maintenance window. thanks all!
